title: Fact-checking with Generative AI: A Systematic Cross-Topic Examination of LLMs Capacity to Detect Veracity of Political Information

bias_targets.methodology: Topic modeling (using BERTopic and K-means) to cluster fact-checked statements into categories, followed by logistic regression analysis to measure how the specific topic of a claim affects the LLMs' accuracy and odds of agreement with ground truth fact-checking labels.
